risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (291.36) indicates extreme market stress, CPI event in 1 day adds near-term volatility; falling DXY provides minor relief for multinational EXPD but insufficient to offset systemic risks.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross + three white soldiers + 15x volume spike create textbook bullish confluence with moderate entry quality and support at 94.60 providing defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI (71/78), weak ADX trend strength, trading below VWAP, zero fundamental conviction, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (291), and CPI event in 1 day create compounding headwinds that outweigh technical setup.
